pr_title: [wasm][debug]Press alt-shift-d and open firefox debug tab attached to the blazor app
pr_body:
Error if firefox is not opened with remote debugging enabled on port 6000:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4503299/213206922-978f1b64-7795-4485-a213-5739e74f93c8.png)

Error if firefox is opened but about:debugging tab is not opened:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4503299/213206936-819254e4-554c-4f4f-b8fd-e5c01ff98cbc.png)

Debugging working:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4503299/213207844-05aeb947-50f5-4dfe-bc20-b6a0b72827b2.mp4




The goal of this PR is give the customer a similar experience that it have when debugging on chrome/edge, on firefox.

Related to https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/46132

Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/80043

issue_context.title: Blazor Debugging on Firefox
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe the problem.

First, thanks for all your great work.

I'm working on a wasm blazor application and using firefox as my daily browser.
Sadly blazor debugging is not supported on firefox and i'm forced to install Chrome or edge to debug my application.

### Describe the solution you'd like

I would like to debug my blazor application on firefox.

### Additional context

In https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/61776 wasm debugging on firefox was added to the runtime.
In the same issue is stated that the 'allowed browser list' https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/580f0fc279c06f14928713604c6e41c1b6dace50/src/Components/Web.JS/src/Platform/Mono/MonoDebugger.ts#L10 should be extended to enable aspnet debugging on firefox.

I don't know if there is more work needed to enable this scenario, but i would like to get the discussion started/get an overview what needs to be done.
